safety_lead_time.comparison_action: Reduce SAP safety lead time from 5.0 days to 1.18 days

narrative: Demand for PL1__M2E56FF7 is smooth and continuously positive (CV=13.9%), averaging 31,278 units per working day over 93 observations, with a statistically significant downward trend. Lead-time variability (CV=48.2%) dominates the buffer requirement, contributing 96.7% of combined variance. A continuous-review (r,Q) policy with EOQ=503,343 units consolidates ~190 annual orders into ~16, cutting total inventory cost by 81.8% while maintaining the 95% service level and respecting the 603,487-unit storage cap.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Smooth, non-intermittent demand with moderate lead-time variability is the canonical fit for a continuous-review (r,Q) policy. It responds to actual stock position in real time, avoids the excess review overhead of periodic systems, and the EOQ formula provides the analytically optimal batch size when demand is approximately stationary.
research_insights.boundary_risk: EOQ (503,343) + safety stock (61,594) = 564,937 units, which is below the 603,487-unit storage cap. The capacity constraint does not bind; no order-quantity reduction is required.
